prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 24 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1256; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Nearly all findings rest on the patient's own pain reports; imaging and exam tests are normal.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain and stiffness radiating into the upper shoulders. The mechanism of injury described is consistent with the type of soft-tissue loading typically seen in this kind of impact, and a diagnosis of cervical strain was made. Over the course of twenty-four visits, care consisted of manual therapy, guided stretching, and home exercise instruction. The patient's course followed a typical pattern, with pain scores and functional limitations gradually easing and visit frequency tapering as recovery progressed. Cervical range of motion, neurological screening, and advanced imaging were all unremarkable, so the clinical picture relies largely on the patient's self-reported symptoms. Review of the history notes a brief strain involving the same region several years ago that resolved completely without lasting limitation. Billing records reflect single, non-duplicated charges for each service rendered. Patient is currently discharged to self-directed home exercise with instructions to return if symptoms recur.
